title: BrookhavenTools
features:
💎 VIP PROPS ULTIMATE - Quick Guide
🚀 Features
Feature	Description
Spawn VIP Props	Spawn all VIP props around your character
Give Tools	Give any tool to selected players or all players
Custom Themes	9 different color themes to personalize your UI
Drag & Drop	Move the window anywhere on screen
Toggle UI	Close/reopen the interface with the toggle button
🎮 How to Use
1. Menu Tab

Click 🔫 Equip PropMaker first

Click 🧹 Clear All Props to remove spawned props

2. VIP Props Tab

Click any prop button to spawn it around you

3. Give Tools Tab

Select a player from the dropdown

Select a tool from the dropdown

Click Give to Selected or Give to ALL

4. Theme Tab

Click any theme to apply it instantly

⚠️ IMPORTANT - Before Running the Script
You MUST manually obtain the PropMaker and tools from the game shop BEFORE executing the script!

If you don't have them in your inventory, the script won't work and you'll need to rejoin the game to fix it.

Steps:

Go to the in-game shop

Get the PropMaker tool

Get any tools you want to give

Then execute the script

⌨️ Controls
Control	Action
Drag Title Bar	Move the window
Click 💎	Reopen GUI
Click ✖	Close GUI
Enjoy! 🚀
